reviewer_objection: Why are nine dimensions necessary rather than four, seven, eight or another number?
required_evidence: Nested model competition, complexity penalty, ablation and sensitivity
failure_consequence: Simplify architecture or narrow necessity claim

reviewer_objection: Are additional dimensions merely increasing distinguishability mechanically?
How does SCDA compare with genuine prior SCM frameworks rather than weak baselines?
required_evidence: Frozen comparator definitions and head-to-head coding

reviewer_objection: Can independent coders reproduce the dimensions?
required_evidence: Stratified independent coding and reliability statistics
failure_consequence: Revise, merge, demote or remove unreliable dimensions

reviewer_objection: Does the result generalize beyond the development corpus?
Do evidence maturity and context add information or just annotation?
required_evidence: Matched-case V and I falsification tests
failure_consequence: Treat as annotations or remove from core

reviewer_objection: Is the corpus systematic and reproducible?
required_evidence: Frozen retrieval registry, manifests, deduplication and screening flow

reviewer_objection: Are claimed gaps merely sparse cells?
required_evidence: Coverage diagnostics and conservative gap rules

reviewer_objection: What does a manager gain from the architecture?
required_evidence: Decision-ambiguity diagnostics with non-causal claim boundary

reviewer_objection: Can every headline number be reproduced?
required_evidence: Artifact provenance graph and frozen commit

reviewer_objection: Does each citation actually support its claim?
required_evidence: Claim provenance ledger with source locators and source-level review

reviewer_objection: Do abstract and conclusion overstate qualified results?
required_evidence: Paper claim map and section-alignment audit

reviewer_objection: Is the review truly double blind?
required_evidence: Identity audit plus manual PDF/supplement inspection

reviewer_objection: Could the preferred architecture change under reasonable analysis choices?
required_evidence: Frozen robustness grid and study-level bootstrap
